verses.pali: “Yesaṁ kesañci, bhikkhave, satta bojjhaṅgā viraddhā, viraddho tesaṁ ariyo maggo sammā dukkhakkhayagāmī.
verses.english: “Mendicants, whoever has missed out on the seven awakening factors has missed out on the noble path to the complete ending of suffering.

verses.pali: Yesaṁ kesañci, bhikkhave, satta bojjhaṅgā āraddhā, āraddho tesaṁ ariyo maggo sammā dukkhakkhayagāmī.
verses.english: Whoever has undertaken the seven awakening factors has undertaken the noble path to the complete ending of suffering.
The awakening factors of mindfulness, investigation of principles, energy, rapture, tranquility, immersion, and equanimity.

verses.pali: yesaṁ kesañci, bhikkhave, ime satta bojjhaṅgā viraddhā, viraddho tesaṁ ariyo maggo sammā dukkhakkhayagāmī.
verses.english: Whoever has missed out on these seven awakening factors has missed out on the noble path to the complete ending of suffering.

verses.pali: Yesaṁ kesañci, bhikkhave, ime satta bojjhaṅgā āraddhā, āraddho tesaṁ ariyo maggo sammā dukkhakkhayagāmī”ti.
verses.english: Whoever has undertaken these seven awakening factors has undertaken the noble path to the complete ending of suffering.”
